I quit the office in March and honestly I haven't missed it. Not once.

The commute was the big thing. Forty minutes each way, which sounds fine until you do the math. That's about two full working days a month spent staring at the back of someone's head on the train. Now I walk the dog instead.

Some of it is worse, though. I miss the random hallway chats. Nobody tells you that remote work kills those, and nothing replaces them. Slack doesn't. I've tried.

My boss thinks I'm more productive. I think I'm just not interrupted every ten minutes, which isn't the same thing. Anyway. It works for me, and I'd fight to keep it.
